title: RTPCR Amplification of SARS-CoV2 Whole Genome for Illumina NGS
author: Monica Galiano
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bew8jfhw
materials: Working in a post-PCR area Use 1% or 2% E-gels 48 wells (Invitrogen) for visualisation of the bands, following manufacturer’s instructions. For each sample prepare 1x 96-well microtiter plate to mix Loading buffer
Keep the PCR plate on a cooler.
Some examples of gel pictures are shown here:

steps.title: Prepare Primer Mix Pairs
steps.instruction: Create working primer dilutions of 5 pmol/µl for SET A (e.g., yellow strip tubes) and SET B (e.g., purple strip tubes).

substeps.instruction: Add 180 µl of water and 10 µl of each Forward and Reverse primer (at 100 pmol/µl) to a tube according to Appendix 2.
Vortex to mix and store at -20 °C.
Thaw primer mixes, briefly vortex, and spin down.
Using a multichannel pipette, load 4 µl of primer mixes into the corresponding wells of a 96-well PCR plate according to Figure 2, keeping the plate on a cooler.

steps.title: Perform Reverse Transcription (RT)
steps.instruction: Set up RT reactions using 140 µl of RNA (kept on ice or stored at -80 °C).

substeps.instruction: Prepare the RT mix: 4.0 µl Water, 4.0 µl 5X VILO Reaction mix, 2.0 µl 10X Superscript Enzyme mix, and 10.0 µl RNA per reaction (Bulk mix for 14 reactions: 56 µl Water, 56 µl 5X VILO, 28 µl 10X Superscript, 140 µl RNA; Final volume 20.0 µl per reaction / 280 µl total).
Aliquot the mix into 7 x 0.2 strip tubes to ensure uniform heat distribution.
Run the cycling program: 25 °C for 10 min, 42 °C for 1 hour, 85 °C for 5 min, then hold at 4 °C.
Keep cDNA on ice or store at -80 °C if not used immediately.

steps.title: Prepare PCR Master Mix
steps.instruction: Prepare a PCR mix for approximately 70 samples (covering sets A and B).

substeps.instruction: Prepare working dilution of dNTPs (100 mM dNTP Set, Invitrogen, cat 10297018): Mix four tubes of dNTPs in one bijou tube and add 1.5 ml of water to reach a concentration of 10 mM (Final volume 2.5 ml); aliquot in 2 ml screw cap tubes.

Prepare the PCR mix (per reaction x 70): 35.8 µl Water (2,506 µl total), 5.0 µl 10X High Fidelity Buffer (350 µl total), 1.0 µl 10 mM dNTPs mix (70 µl total), 2.0 µl 50mM MgSO4 (140 µl total), and 0.2 µl Platinum Taq DNA Polymerase 5 U/µl (14 µl total). Final volume per reaction: 44.0 µl (3,080 µl total).
Mix with a gentle vortex and keep on ice.

steps.title: Set Up and Run PCR
steps.instruction: Combine the PCR mix, primers, and cDNA for amplification.

substeps.instruction: Dispense 44 µl of the PCR mix into every well containing primers for rows A, B, C, E, F, and G.
Pool all 7 cDNA strip tubes into one and load 4 µl of cDNA into each well.
Cover the 96-well plate with an adhesive lid or strip caps and spin briefly.
Amplify in a thermal cycler: 95 °C for 10 min, followed by 35 cycles of (94 °C for 30 sec, 52 °C for 30 sec, 68 °C for 5 min), then hold at 15 °C.

steps.title: Verify Amplicons via Gel Electrophoresis
steps.instruction: Run PCR products on E-gels to check for amplification.

substeps.instruction: Prepare diluted Blue Juice (1/25 or 1/50): Mix 10 ml TBE buffer with 400 µl (1/25) or 200 µl (1/50) undiluted Blue Juice.
Add 10 µl of diluted Blue Juice to every well of rows A, B, C, E, F, and G using a multichannel pipette.
Transfer 5 µl of sample from the PCR plate to a microtiter plate using a multichannel pipette.
Prepare ladder mix: 14 µl diluted Blue Juice + 1 µl of 1 Kb Plus Ladder for wells marked M.
Transfer 15 µl of samples and ladder dilutions into E-gels. Load 15 µl of diluted Blue Juice in empty wells. Run for 20 minutes and view under shortwave U.V.
Alternative loading: Load sample A in odd wells and sample B in even wells for rows B to F, with ladder in wells M at the start and end of each gel row.

steps.title: Prepare Equimolar Mixes
steps.instruction: Create rough equimolar mixes of amplicons based on gel band brightness.

substeps.instruction: For each set (A and B separately), mix the appropriate amount of each amplicon in an Eppendorf tube (final volume 60 to 300 µl), excluding the negative control.
Use the following volumes based on band intensity: 3 µl for a strong band, 5 µl for a normal band, and 10 µl for a weak or non-visible band.

steps.title: Purify and Quantify DNA
steps.instruction: Purify the pooled PCR products and determine DNA concentration.

substeps.instruction: Purify PCR products using QIAquick PCR purification kit columns per manufacturer's instructions, using repeated additions and spins until all sample has passed through the column.
Elute purified DNA in 50 µl of molecular grade water.
Quantify DNA using Qubit dsDNA HS reagent and a Qubit fluorometer according to manufacturer's instructions.

steps.title: Final Dilution
steps.instruction: Dilute samples to the appropriate concentration for Illumina library preparation using Nextera XT.
